run_ALTS_server: run the gRPC server with ALTS credentials on localhost:23333 in a GCP environment
create_ALTS_server: create a gRPC server using ALTS encryption and a ThreadPoolExecutor for handling requests
add_secure_port: add a secure port to the gRPC server using ALTS server credentials
register_servicer: register a DemoServer servicer to the gRPC server via add_GRPCDemoServicer_to_server
start_and_wait_server: start the gRPC server and block until termination using wait_for_termination
